source_metadata.title: Methicillin-Resistant Staphylococcus aureus USA400 Clone, Italy

extraction_scope.excluded_material: Unrelated next letter beginning on journal page 996 was excluded.
extraction_scope.batching: Not used; source was short and semantically compact.

findings: No cross-batch duplicate review was required because batching was not used.
Related treatment-description and treatment-response atoms were retained because they represent distinct independently reviewable assertions.

extraction_limitations: This is a brief letter/case report with one patient and no comparator group.
The letter states that molecular investigation and typing used established methods but does not provide full procedural detail in the article text.
Treatment response is a single-patient observation and was not converted into a quantitative treatment-effect atom.
Background statements summarizing other publications were not atomized as if they were primary results generated by this article.
schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema has no dedicated case-presentation or microbiologic-isolate-characterization atom kind; source-supported case observations were represented with population_description, method, qualitative_result, intervention_description, and author_conclusion.
